reviews.t: Good value if you’re not too picky about make-up brushes
reviews.x: Look...you can’t buy a set of 32 brushes for $7 and expect to receive a super high-end product. However, these brushes are perfectly usable. The bristles on some of the brushes remind a little bit of what you find with craft brushes, but they are soft and fairly dense and they do a decent job. I bought this set for my daughter because she does stage make-up for the students in her high school plays, and let’s be honest...the price is right for this type of use. There are enough brushes that she

Great product. Brushes have a nice feel. I ordered the black color and it looks great. Packaging was great and shipment was fast. It does have a chemical smell to it but from what i read a shampoo wash will get that smell out.

Okay, so I’ve barely received them today. I can say right off the bat that as soon as I opened the package, there was a really strong smell coming from the brush set. It smells like new flip flops from Old Navy lol. I’m hoping that by the time I start using the brushes, the smell has worn off. I don’t want to be using these on my face and then my face smells odd. I’m so far airing them out in these cup looking things that have crystals on them in a bed of marbles to elevate them in the cups sinc
[[VIDEOID:8ac319dcb5d9bf270760b1c76c70680a]] I’m giving it 4 stars because I haven’t tried them out yet & also they smelled like wet paint when I opened them up.

reviews.t: Do not buy even if you think it's cheap do not they suck
reviews.x: Horrible horrible horrible these aren't even real brushes they are so bad actually I allowed my child to use them for paint and even then they still suck so they immediately broke every single one of them I had to clamp them back together again and they don't even hold makeup they don't apply the makeup smoothly they just completely suck it's a joke and a waste of money even if it is just a few dollars don't waste your time you're better off going to the Dollar Store

Super disappointed when opening these brushes after I got home from work today to find that the brush head on the first brush I took out fell right off. I will be returning this item, I had read several reviews before choosing this seems quantity over quality in this situation.

Decent bristles.  Fairly soft, not scratchy.  The handles are plastic and lightweight - little heft.  This is a 'travel set'; bought after a managed to loose an IT brush when travelling.  It has every brush you could need.
I bought these make up brushes for my wife. She really loved this 32 piece kit. They are practicable and easy to use.
Soft brushes. Odd smell, but it wasn't too pungent. All brushes were there.

reviews.t: Son maravillosas y traen todas las medidas
reviews.x: Recibi conforme,  son fabulosas, eran lo que esperaba las recomiendo
I still love these brushes but they fall apart pretty easily

reviews.t: Some brushes are better than others.
reviews.x: I got these brushes when they were on sale ($9 for 32 brushes...), and I didn't expect much for the price but I read some reviews and they seemed worth your money.  They came in an easily-washable bag and were organized by size, none were missing, and they were packaged well.  I didn't notice a bad chemical smell like some reviews said they had, but I still washed them like you should with any new brush.  The larger brushes, like the contour, blush, etc.  brushes were quite soft and flexible, th

They're ok...for the price, I guess having a few misses is ok, but I wouldn't recommend nor repurchase. The way the rolled package is sort of warps a few of the larger brushes...the eyeshadow brushes are all flat brushes so if you're looking for blenders, this kit is not it. There is a flat top smaller one that can be used for the crease, but it's a super awkwardly shaped brush...for the price, as mentioned, to get a couple good brushes I guess it's ok.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for!
reviews.x: These brushes were good for the price. you get what you pay for. I'm not picky with my makeup brushes so it doesn't really matter to me and they don't have an ugly design on them which I appreciate. they are pretty soft the only thing I wish is that the brushes were more full. But they are still really good for the price.

They're so soft and i love using them but after a while of using them and I'm talking like 2-3 months some of the brushes came off of the sticks so i don't know if its because i washed them to vigorously or if its because of the brushes i didn't wash them that much only about every two weeks because I'm just lazy

reviews.t: Cheap and easily breakable brush set
reviews.x: I got these brushes to travel with, I took them out of town with me for a weekend and the bristles came out along with the entire top of 4 of them. The brushes are not as soft as normal brushes and they had the same types of texture making it hard to pick up makeup. I guess you get what you pay for...

With my first use the bristles were falling out and falling all over my face. But I guess that’s a good thing because while it is in tact the bristles were irritating my skin. I’m not an extreme make up lady either, I just use it for my daily basics.. or at least I tried.

I bought this set as a little gift for my friend; it's unexpectedly good. I don't even know there are so many different kinds of brushes. They were all come in good condition, completely new and clean, well-protected. The hair is soft enough for its price.

These brushes were exactly the same. Stems of the brushes were too short. I had over 10 of the same style of eye makeup brush. I was hoping for a blending brush, precision brush, brow brush... Nope just a bunch of duds that were EXACTLY the same.

So, these brushes are not worth $8. they’re cheap. they’re small, and if you think they’re good for eyeshadow you are incorrect. The brushes are awkward shapes, and cheaply made, you cannot make good eyeshadow looks with these. do not recommend

the bristle quality is amazing and so is packaging but the glue holding the brushes to the handles break very easy, also the eye shadow brushes are not of different variations so it’s hard to create a fully blended look with them

reviews.t: You get what you pay for!!!
reviews.x: These brushes are great for the price but were falling apart before even taking them out their case (brush falling off handle, etc). They are soft and work perfectly for what I bought them for...painting my face for raves.

Why I gave bad reviews right then read First the brushes r look so cheap you can see by the pic I uploaded, and it’s not  that much softness what shown in pictures lol. Still I like It like you get what you paid lol 😂

The presentation packing was nice, softness was not the soft you'd expect.. it's the cheap kind of softness.  However shipping was fast.  Over all I guess you get what you pay for.  Disappointed at the quality.

This came in the cutest package. I love that they look very professional. I got it for my daughter to play around with, but I'm thinking I might take it. haha Packaging and shipping were really good. Thank you!

claims.text: Many reviewers consider the brushes good value for the low price, though some note you get what you pay for.
Several reviewers mention a strong chemical or odd smell when first opening the package.
Some reviewers report brushes breaking or falling apart, including brush heads detaching and handles coming off.
Reviewers frequently describe the bristles as soft and usable.
A few reviewers note the brushes are small or that some brushes in the set are lower quality than others.
